startup.readiness: Toolkit connection verified before modeling admission
startup.existing_sessions: Reuse selected/unique session; never close Creo automatically

result.modeling: Composable native Creo features; geometry is not restricted to a plate recipe

syntax.single_selection: A bare {kind:...} object, passed directly to the named parameter
syntax.geometry_id: Model geometry ID from inspection, not a feature ID
syntax.feature_label: An MCP feature alias; use the geometry-specific kind
syntax.datum_feature: Normally a datum plane label; axis_pattern.axis accepts it as an axis-label compatibility alias
syntax.example_ids: IDs below are illustrative. Inspect the actual model and replace them; labels must exist in that model
syntax.collection_vs_selection: Round/chamfer sets and sketch supports contain selections; they are not interchangeable with a single selection

creo_axis_pattern.requires: A geometric axis, preceding the leader. A plane's axis/normal does not define a rotation axis

creo_datum_axis.alternative: A cylindrical face, straight edge or existing axis, subject to actual geometry

creo_boolean_bodies.requires: Explicit distinct body IDs, not feature IDs

creo_solidify.limits: Quilt add/cut still requires actual geometry and installation-specific acceptance

creo_surface_fill.requires: Sketch feature label or feature ID, not a {kind:...} selection object

creo_sheetmetal_flange.requires: Bare edge selection; pass edge={kind:'edge',id:N}, without an extra reference/edge wrapper

creo_round.requires: A list of sets: each set contains edge or two surfaces. A list of bare edge selections is not a set list

creo_create_sketch.alternative: XY/XZ/YZ string for a principal plane
creo_create_sketch.requires: For a dictionary plane, put the support selection under reference; origin/u_axis are optional frame fields

result.workflow: submit once -> poll get_job -> inspect model -> choose references -> append using expected_revision
result.scope: MCP-owned native part, sheetmetal, assembly and drawing models. Tool availability does not prove every option or Creo operation is supported; consult validation evidence and coverage documentation.

seed_library.validation: SHA256 and published metadata; native type/count/mode are checked during creation

direct_blend_callback.runtime_readiness: Native worker checks the active Creo DLL handle and protocol for each loft; artifacts alone do not confirm readiness
direct_blend_callback.instruction: In Creo Auxiliary Applications, register protk.dat and start this application; review any DLL prompt yourself. Modeling never changes the security policy.

result.release_status: pre-release candidate; requested complete coverage has not been achieved

seed_library.scope: MIT native seeds bundled with source; SHA256 validation, local registration and automatic count/mode selection
seed_library.limits: no automatic download, arbitrary seed generation or mode/count conversion

airfoil.scope: symmetric NACA 00xx native sketch splines; chord/thickness/twist/origin/pivot edits preserve sketch and Blend IDs
airfoil.native_test: five smooth stations, two sequential middle-section edits and edit after a native group axis pattern; STL section comparison
airfoil.limits: no camber; metadata driven MCP edits, not Creo relation-driven airfoil dimensions; creation-time sample count is fixed

sketch_dimensioning.scope: auto selects native coordinate dimensions on principal planes for supported undimensioned profiles with at least 10 expanded entities or coordinate/radius magnitude above 1000 mm; coordinates can be requested explicitly
sketch_dimensioning.native_test: 19-line large-coordinate profile, R40000 12-gon, large capsule on XY and rotated/translated XZ, large YZ circle and explicit-coordinate rectangle; native sketch/solid IDs, named dimension edits, STL boundaries and save/erase/reload verified
sketch_dimensioning.limits: coordinates supports line/centerline/rectangle/polyline/circle/arc on XY/XZ/YZ, without user dimensions/constraints; actual geometry checked to 1e-5 mm when creating/replacing; spline/ellipse and arbitrary planes use autodim; no normalization or rigid solving; not proof of every constraint or extreme shape

sketch_geometry_edit.scope: in-place geometry replacement; entity names/types/counts and sketch feature ID retained; dimensions rebuilt using auto/autodim/coordinates
sketch_geometry_edit.native_test: large 19-line and capsule replacements preserve downstream extrusion IDs, geometry, saved reload; failed dimension assertions roll back and live refresh confirms restoration
sketch_geometry_edit.limits: replaces prior dimensions/constraints and clears airfoil metadata; query new named dimension IDs after replacement; spline/ellipse retain the original autodim path; coordinate mode cannot be mixed with user constraints

placement.scope: native body FlexMove or quilt/geometry Move, in-place translation/rotation edits, local feature groups, reorder and axis patterns
placement.native_test: body rotate/translate/edit with true solid bounding boxes; quilt rotate/translate/thicken/edit; five-section blade group pattern and later airfoil edit; save/erase/reload
placement.limits: body branch can require Flexible Modeling license; copy-original, multiple bodies, custom csys, complex quilts and datum/curve combinations require local validation

drawing.scope: native DRW sheets, general/projected views, driving dimensions, notes, tables, edits, deletion and PDF
drawing.limits: owned part/sheetmetal snapshots; no live source update, assembly drawings, sections, detail views, GD&T or automatic BOM

datums.scope: coordinate systems and dimensioned point arrays in addition to planes and axes
datums.native_test: XYZ offsets 10/20/30, Z rotation 45 degrees, native origin check and offset dimension edit

surface_solid.native_test: 20 x 10 fill, symmetric thickness 2 to 3; plane cut of a cube
surface_solid.limits: closed-quilt solidification, curved-quilt offset/cut and all side options need further validation

boolean_bodies.native_test: overlapping cubes: union 1500, difference 500 and intersection 500 mm3
boolean_bodies.limits: multi-target/tool lists and keep_tools require further native validation

rib.scope: native profile rib driven by an open sketch
rib.limits: sketch must intersect the solid; material side depends on sketch direction; trajectory ribs are not wrapped

udf.scope: local UDF metadata and independent native feature-group placement with reference/variable-dimension mapping
udf.limits: part/sheetmetal only; exact reference prompts required; assembly UDFs, quadrants, variable parameters and manufacturing UDFs are not wrapped; libraries supplied by user

mirror.native_test: whole solid about a principal datum plane
mirror.limits: whole-part/geometry references only; feature/subtree mirror is rejected

sweep.native_test: straight and quarter-circle trajectories; solid add, straight cut, open surface followed by thicken, symmetric thin; named section edits, native ID preservation, analytic volume checks, save/erase/reload and failed-assertion rollback on 2026-10-11
sweep.limits: constant section; compound trajectories, all frame options, capped surfaces and intersections still require local validation; thin is total symmetric wall thickness

draft.native_test: constant unsplit draft on a planar face with a planar neutral reference
draft.limits: variable, split and rib draft are not high-level tools

loft.scope: direct native solid Blend from independent MCP-owned XY sketches ordered by increasing Z; create in a feature plan or append to an owned part
loft.native_test: 3/4/6 straight and smooth factory cases; append 3/smooth to an existing saved base, preserve native IDs, edit dimensions, verify all-section STL, save/erase/reload and failed-append rollback with a live refresh
loft.limits: solid add into the default body only; no cut/surface/new_body, nonparallel sections or endpoint tangency/curvature controls; native reports support Chinese/English Creo; requires explicit resident callback initialization before modeling under every loader policy, otherwise rejects before DLL load; modeling never loads DLLs or changes security policy
loft.callback_setup: creo_capabilities.direct_blend_callback lists the generated registry_file; load/start it via Creo Auxiliary Applications and review the DLL prompt before modeling

loft_seed.scope: new native part by rebinding an automatically selected bundled seed or explicit compatible seed to new XY sketch/airfoil sections
loft_seed.mode_verification: requested interpolation must match the saved seed; native PRO_FEAT_INFO checked before save, after parameter edits and after reload
loft_seed.native_test: five-section smooth rectangles and NACA 0012 spline airfoils; middle sketch/plane edits; saved reload, all-section STL checks and failed-assertion rollback; two-section rectangle/circle/triangle regression
loft_seed.limits: requires a saved solid Blend seed with matching section count and interpolation, Chinese/English Creo; XY sketches with strictly increasing Z offsets; no seed section insertion/removal, mode conversion, cut/surface or tangency controls; use direct loft for existing-target insertion; seed endpoint settings and datums are inherited; input range is not proof that every count/profile is tested; free endpoints may produce identical geometry with two sections

sheetmetal.scope: first flat wall, attached flange, unbend, bend-back and flat pattern
sheetmetal.native_test: 40 x 30 x 1 wall, 90 degree flange with R2/R3 bend, followed by unfolding and refolding
sheetmetal.limits: first wall uses thin extrusion then native conversion; bend relief, forms, hems and jogs are not high-level tools

assembly.native_test: part snapshots, rigid placement, removal, 3 datum-plane align constraints and 20 mm offset
assembly.limits: MCP-owned part/sheetmetal sources; no nested assemblies; source edits do not update snapshots; mate/insert/csys/default placement need further validation

verified_evidence.scope: v0.2.5 selected-item acceptance is separate from historical feature suites; full Creo coverage is not claimed

airfoil.native_type: ordinary solid smooth Blend and independent native sketch splines

quilt_transform.native_type: Move with coordinate-system-bound support points and axes

limitations: Automatic seeds: 2/straight, 2/smooth, 5/smooth; no count/mode conversion or unseeded Blend creation
NACA 00xx symmetric profiles; MCP metadata-driven sketch redefinition, not native relation-driven airfoil dimensions
Body/quilt move-original branches verified; copies, multiple bodies, custom frames and other geometry combinations require local validation
VSS, Swept Blend, Boundary Blend and complete Creo coverage remain outside this increment

development_025.validation_version_note: Native modeling acceptance was completed while the development label was 0.2.4, then the same native implementation was released as 0.2.5. Protocol, version, tool discovery, seed hashes and automatic tests were checked for 0.2.5. Historical reports retain their original version labels.
limits: No coordinate normalization or rigid solving is exposed.
Coordinate dimensioning is limited to supported line/circle/arc profiles on principal planes without user dimensions/constraints; other profiles retain autodim.
Direct Blend is restricted to MCP-owned XY sections ordered by actual increasing Z, solid add into the default body.
The four sweep cases and nine seed pairs do not prove every parameter combination.
No claim of complete Creo coverage.

loft_seed.name: MCP_CREO_MechDog
loft_seed.scope: new parts from a user-supplied two-section native Blend seed
limits: Requires a saved dedicated solid Blend seed in mm with the requested interpolation setting
This regression suite uses exactly two XY sketches with increasing Z offsets; seed bottom sketch created and selected first
Multisection validation is reported separately in validation_multisection.json
No existing-target insertion, nonparallel sections, cut/surface mode or tangency controls
interpolation checks the seed mode; it does not convert a straight seed to smooth or vice versa
Two sections with free endpoints may have the same geometry in straight and smooth modes
Other contours and seeds require individual verification; seed settings and datums are inherited

limits: Requires a dedicated saved mm solid Blend seed with the requested section count and interpolation
2 to 20 independent closed XY sketches; offsets strictly increase, seed sketches created and selected low Z first

startup.readiness: Toolkit connection verified before modeling admission
startup.existing_sessions: Reuse selected/unique session; never close Creo automatically

result.modeling: Composable native Creo features; geometry is not restricted to a plate recipe

syntax.single_selection: A bare {kind:...} object, passed directly to the named parameter
syntax.geometry_id: Model geometry ID from inspection, not a feature ID
syntax.feature_label: An MCP feature alias; use the geometry-specific kind
syntax.datum_feature: Normally a datum plane label; axis_pattern.axis accepts it as an axis-label compatibility alias
syntax.example_ids: IDs below are illustrative. Inspect the actual model and replace them; labels must exist in that model
syntax.collection_vs_selection: Round/chamfer sets and sketch supports contain selections; they are not interchangeable with a single selection

creo_axis_pattern.requires: A geometric axis, preceding the leader. A plane's axis/normal does not define a rotation axis

creo_datum_axis.alternative: A cylindrical face, straight edge or existing axis, subject to actual geometry

creo_boolean_bodies.requires: Explicit distinct body IDs, not feature IDs

creo_solidify.limits: Quilt add/cut still requires actual geometry and installation-specific acceptance

creo_surface_fill.requires: Sketch feature label or feature ID, not a {kind:...} selection object

creo_sheetmetal_flange.requires: Bare edge selection; pass edge={kind:'edge',id:N}, without an extra reference/edge wrapper

creo_round.requires: A list of sets: each set contains edge or two surfaces. A list of bare edge selections is not a set list

creo_create_sketch.alternative: XY/XZ/YZ string for a principal plane
creo_create_sketch.requires: For a dictionary plane, put the support selection under reference; origin/u_axis are optional frame fields

result.workflow: submit once -> poll get_job -> inspect model -> choose references -> append using expected_revision

seed_library.validation: SHA256 and published metadata; native type/count/mode are checked during creation

direct_blend_callback.runtime_readiness: Native worker checks the active Creo DLL handle and protocol for each loft; artifacts alone do not confirm readiness
direct_blend_callback.instruction: In Creo Auxiliary Applications, register protk.dat and start this application; review any DLL prompt yourself. Modeling never changes the security policy.

result.release_status: pre-release candidate; requested complete coverage has not been achieved

seed_library.scope: MIT native seeds bundled with source; SHA256 validation, local registration and automatic count/mode selection
seed_library.limits: no automatic download, arbitrary seed generation or mode/count conversion

airfoil.scope: symmetric NACA 00xx native sketch splines; chord/thickness/twist/origin/pivot edits preserve sketch and Blend IDs
airfoil.native_test: five smooth stations, two sequential middle-section edits and edit after a native group axis pattern; STL section comparison
airfoil.limits: no camber; metadata driven MCP edits, not Creo relation-driven airfoil dimensions; creation-time sample count is fixed

sketch_dimensioning.scope: auto selects native coordinate dimensions on principal planes for supported undimensioned profiles with at least 10 expanded entities or coordinate/radius magnitude above 1000 mm; coordinates can be requested explicitly
sketch_dimensioning.native_test: 19-line large-coordinate profile, R40000 12-gon, large capsule on XY and rotated/translated XZ, large YZ circle and explicit-coordinate rectangle; native sketch/solid IDs, named dimension edits, STL boundaries and save/erase/reload verified
sketch_dimensioning.limits: coordinates supports line/centerline/rectangle/polyline/circle/arc on XY/XZ/YZ, without user dimensions/constraints; actual geometry checked to 1e-5 mm when creating/replacing; spline/ellipse and arbitrary planes use autodim; no normalization or rigid solving; not proof of every constraint or extreme shape

sketch_geometry_edit.scope: in-place geometry replacement; entity names/types/counts and sketch feature ID retained; dimensions rebuilt using auto/autodim/coordinates
sketch_geometry_edit.native_test: large 19-line and capsule replacements preserve downstream extrusion IDs, geometry, saved reload; failed dimension assertions roll back and live refresh confirms restoration
sketch_geometry_edit.limits: replaces prior dimensions/constraints and clears airfoil metadata; query new named dimension IDs after replacement; spline/ellipse retain the original autodim path; coordinate mode cannot be mixed with user constraints

placement.scope: native body FlexMove or quilt/geometry Move, in-place translation/rotation edits, local feature groups, reorder and axis patterns
placement.native_test: body rotate/translate/edit with true solid bounding boxes; quilt rotate/translate/thicken/edit; five-section blade group pattern and later airfoil edit; save/erase/reload
placement.limits: body branch can require Flexible Modeling license; copy-original, multiple bodies, custom csys, complex quilts and datum/curve combinations require local validation

drawing.scope: native DRW sheets, general/projected views, driving dimensions, notes, tables, edits, deletion and PDF
drawing.limits: owned part/sheetmetal snapshots; no live source update, assembly drawings, sections, detail views, GD&T or automatic BOM

datums.scope: coordinate systems and dimensioned point arrays in addition to planes and axes
datums.native_test: XYZ offsets 10/20/30, Z rotation 45 degrees, native origin check and offset dimension edit

surface_solid.native_test: 20 x 10 fill, symmetric thickness 2 to 3; plane cut of a cube
surface_solid.limits: closed-quilt solidification, curved-quilt offset/cut and all side options need further validation

boolean_bodies.native_test: overlapping cubes: union 1500, difference 500 and intersection 500 mm3
boolean_bodies.limits: multi-target/tool lists and keep_tools require further native validation

rib.scope: native profile rib driven by an open sketch
rib.limits: sketch must intersect the solid; material side depends on sketch direction; trajectory ribs are not wrapped

udf.scope: local UDF metadata and independent native feature-group placement with reference/variable-dimension mapping
udf.limits: part/sheetmetal only; exact reference prompts required; assembly UDFs, quadrants, variable parameters and manufacturing UDFs are not wrapped; libraries supplied by user

mirror.native_test: whole solid about a principal datum plane
mirror.limits: whole-part/geometry references only; feature/subtree mirror is rejected

sweep.native_test: straight and quarter-circle trajectories; solid add, straight cut, open surface followed by thicken, symmetric thin; named section edits, native ID preservation, analytic volume checks, save/erase/reload and failed-assertion rollback on 2026-10-11
sweep.limits: constant section; compound trajectories, all frame options, capped surfaces and intersections still require local validation; thin is total symmetric wall thickness

draft.native_test: constant unsplit draft on a planar face with a planar neutral reference
draft.limits: variable, split and rib draft are not high-level tools

loft.scope: direct native solid Blend from independent MCP-owned XY sketches ordered by increasing Z; create in a feature plan or append to an owned part
loft.native_test: 3/4/6 straight and smooth factory cases; append 3/smooth to an existing saved base, preserve native IDs, edit dimensions, verify all-section STL, save/erase/reload and failed-append rollback with a live refresh
loft.limits: solid add into the default body only; no cut/surface/new_body, nonparallel sections or endpoint tangency/curvature controls; native reports support Chinese/English Creo; requires explicit resident callback initialization before modeling under every loader policy, otherwise rejects before DLL load; modeling never loads DLLs or changes security policy
loft.callback_setup: creo_capabilities.direct_blend_callback lists the generated registry_file; load/start it via Creo Auxiliary Applications and review the DLL prompt before modeling

loft_seed.scope: new native part by rebinding an automatically selected bundled seed or explicit compatible seed to new XY sketch/airfoil sections
loft_seed.mode_verification: requested interpolation must match the saved seed; native PRO_FEAT_INFO checked before save, after parameter edits and after reload
loft_seed.native_test: five-section smooth rectangles and NACA 0012 spline airfoils; middle sketch/plane edits; saved reload, all-section STL checks and failed-assertion rollback; two-section rectangle/circle/triangle regression
loft_seed.limits: requires a saved solid Blend seed with matching section count and interpolation, Chinese/English Creo; XY sketches with strictly increasing Z offsets; no seed section insertion/removal, mode conversion, cut/surface or tangency controls; use direct loft for existing-target insertion; seed endpoint settings and datums are inherited; input range is not proof that every count/profile is tested; free endpoints may produce identical geometry with two sections

sheetmetal.scope: first flat wall, attached flange, unbend, bend-back and flat pattern
sheetmetal.native_test: 40 x 30 x 1 wall, 90 degree flange with R2/R3 bend, followed by unfolding and refolding
sheetmetal.limits: first wall uses thin extrusion then native conversion; bend relief, forms, hems and jogs are not high-level tools

assembly.native_test: part snapshots, rigid placement, removal, 3 datum-plane align constraints and 20 mm offset
assembly.limits: MCP-owned part/sheetmetal sources; no nested assemblies; source edits do not update snapshots; mate/insert/csys/default placement need further validation

verified_evidence.scope: v0.2.5 selected-item acceptance is separate from historical feature suites; full Creo coverage is not claimed

airfoil.native_type: ordinary solid smooth Blend and independent native sketch splines

quilt_transform.native_type: Move with coordinate-system-bound support points and axes

limitations: Automatic seeds: 2/straight, 2/smooth, 5/smooth; no count/mode conversion or unseeded Blend creation
NACA 00xx symmetric profiles; MCP metadata-driven sketch redefinition, not native relation-driven airfoil dimensions
Body/quilt move-original branches verified; copies, multiple bodies, custom frames and other geometry combinations require local validation
VSS, Swept Blend, Boundary Blend and complete Creo coverage remain outside this increment

development_025.validation_version_note: Native modeling acceptance was completed while the development label was 0.2.4, then the same native implementation was released as 0.2.5. Protocol, version, tool discovery, seed hashes and automatic tests were checked for 0.2.5. Historical reports retain their original version labels.
limits: No coordinate normalization or rigid solving is exposed.
Coordinate dimensioning is limited to supported line/circle/arc profiles on principal planes without user dimensions/constraints; other profiles retain autodim.
Direct Blend is restricted to MCP-owned XY sections ordered by actual increasing Z, solid add into the default body.
The four sweep cases and nine seed pairs do not prove every parameter combination.
No claim of complete Creo coverage.

extra_probe_source:
"""Plan success and non-XY rejection via the real stdio public interface."""
import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import math
import pathlib
import sys
import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from mcp import Client
from mcp.client.stdio import StdioServerParameters
from tools.dev_check import git_state, source_hash
from tools.test_direct_loft import Probe, circle_sections, small_solid, verify_blend

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'build/bug007_extra_probe.json'

async def run():
    report = {'work_item': 'BUG-007', 'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              'source': {**git_state(ROOT), 'fingerprints': {
                  p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): source_hash(p)
                  for p in [ROOT/'server.py', ROOT/'native/blend_create.cpp', ROOT/'native/blend_sync.cpp']
              }}, 'calls': [], 'jobs': [], 'success': False}
    probe = None
    try:
        async with Client(StdioServerParameters(command=sys.executable, args=[str(ROOT/'server.py')], cwd=ROOT), read_timeout_seconds=65) as client:
            probe = Probe(client, report, OUTPUT, 900)
            report['capabilities'] = await probe.call('creo_capabilities', {})
            deadline = time.monotonic()+130
            while True:
                startup = await probe.call('creo_startup_status', {})
                if startup['state'] == 'ready': break
                assert startup['state'] in {'checking','building_worker','starting','waiting_for_connection'} and time.monotonic()<deadline, startup
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
            report['session'] = await probe.call('creo_session_status', {})
            assert report['session']['connected']
            checkpoint = await probe.job('creo_execute_plan', {'model_name':'bug007_plan_'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:10], 'operations':circle_sections()}, 'plan_checkpoint')
            result = await probe.job('creo_execute_plan', {'model_id':checkpoint['model_id'], 'expected_revision':checkpoint['revision'], 'operations':[{'op':'loft','label':'blend_probe','sections':['sk_a','sk_b'],'mode':'add','interpolation':'straight','new_body':False}]}, 'plan_loft_success')
            verify_blend(result,2,'straight',checkpoint,4900*math.pi/3)
            operations = [{**op,'plane':'XZ'} for op in circle_sections()]
            checkpoint = await probe.job('creo_execute_plan', {'model_name':'bug007_xz_'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12], 'operations':operations}, 'non_xy_checkpoint')
            before = await probe.call('creo_inspect_model',{'model_id':checkpoint['model_id']})
            file = pathlib.Path(checkpoint['result']['part_file'])
            digest = hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            result = await probe.job('creo_loft', {'model_id':checkpoint['model_id'],'expected_revision':checkpoint['revision'],'label':'blend_probe','sections':['sk_a','sk_b'],'interpolation':'straight'}, 'non_xy_rejected', expected_failure=True)
            assert 'XY' in result['message'], result
            assert result['result']['rollback_succeeded']
            assert probe.report['jobs'][-1]['elapsed_seconds'] < 30
            after = await probe.call('creo_inspect_model',{'model_id':checkpoint['model_id']})
            for key in ['revision','part_file','inspection','aliases']: assert after[key]==before[key], key
            assert hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
            await probe.job('creo_execute_plan',{'operations':small_solid(),'assertions':{'volume_mm3':2000}},'post_non_xy_small_solid')
            report['success'] = True
    except Exception as exc:
        report['failure'] = repr(exc)
        report['writes_stopped_for_uncertain_outcome'] = bool(probe and probe.uncertain)
    finally:
        report['finished_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    return report

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(0 if asyncio.run(run())['success'] else 1)
